correctness.rationale: Payoff difference for focal agent against j A-neighbors is exactly j-t for threshold t=a or b; tie retention implies inside a+1..b the count chain has up probability p(N-i)/N and down (1-p)i/N, while outside it moves monotonically to consensus. Reversible binomial conductances c_j=pi_j p(N-j)/N yield P_i=L_i/R via the harmonic equation and a Dirichlet Green kernel pi_k L_min(i,k)(R-L_max(i,k))/R for exit time, followed by coupon-collector cleanup NH_a or NH_(N-b-1). Stirling estimates on resistors and upper/lower positive Green bounds give min of two binary-KL entropy barriers and the winner exponents; strictly decreasing barrier difference yields unique p*. Direct independent rational Bellman checks in three finite models passed. This is not a statement for sparse layers.
